We remain optimistic about the outlook for Kenya’s enterprise sector. Improvingmacroeconomic
stability, accommodative monetary policy and regional tradeopportunities provide a supportive
foundation for growth. Our priorities going forward include.
• Deepening sector‑led propositions to strengthen our relevance and impact across key industries
driving the economy.
• Scaling digital solutions through a tailored business banking platform that meets evolving client
needs.
• Expanding our sustainable finance offering to further drive positive Impact.
• Executing our strategy with discipline to deliver consistent results and create lasting value for our
clients and shareholders.
